# A good per-claim rate can still be a bad trip.

> Free calculator for independent catastrophe (CAT) claims adjusters: find real net profit for a storm deployment after estimating-software, lodging, per diem, vehicle, and unpaid travel-day cost, then compare IA firms' fee schedules by what they actually pay per hour.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
